name: board-shows-a-row-nothing-in-the-file-created
justification: Everything in the evidence points at the wrong file, which is what makes this shape worth a fixture. The assertion, the stack and the snippet are all in the failing spec, and that spec is correct: it reads what the board shows and compares it against the seed. The extra row was left by a different spec that adds a task and never removes it, and nothing in the failing test touches it. The tempting alternative is app_code — the application did put a row on the board — but it was asked to create that row and did, so there is no product defect to point at. Rule 2 fires: the suite depends on state another test left, so the failing spec is not a valid detector. Intermittent because whether the two files land in one worker in sequence depends on how long the others took: 6 failures in 18 runs, alternating.
